body:
Pass 22. Swept for other instances of the p0 - there are three sites, not one, all densifying the same m-by-p sparse frame:

  measurement.R:494               .additive_frame_signature
  measurement.R:511               .measurement_frame_from_additive  (also calls :494 at :513, so twice)
  measurement-decomposition.R:76  frame decomposition

Only the first fires today; the other two are latent in the measurement-form and decomposition subsystems - the half that still has to reach brain scale. Worth one canonicalized helper for all three.

Checked and clean so you do not re-audit them: metric.R:608-621 handles sparse rows properly via Matrix::summary; the as.matrix calls in measurement-kernel, measurement-result and evidence-task are all on query$operator which is q-by-q and small; support-index.R:158/208 are expand.grid offsets.

Your Epic 7 note about removing per-edge global combined-pair vectors is chasing the same class of thing - global p-scale allocations - so it may be cheap to fold these in while you are there.
